plugins.name: unknowns
plugins.description: Know your unknowns — an operating loop for the gap between the map (your plan) and the territory (the actual code and domain). Eleven skills: blind-spot investigation, domain primers, interviews, divergent prototypes, brainstorming, reference analysis, tweak-likelihood-ordered planning, deviation notes, buy-in docs and comprehension quizzes — plus two agents and two hooks.
